dataset.name: SEQC neuroblastoma cohort (GSE62564/GSE49711)
dataset.description: Independent 498-patient primary-neuroblastoma cohort with gene-level bulk RNA sequencing and individual overall-survival follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: The MAQC-III/SEQC project profiled 498 primary neuroblastomas. TRACE Explorer links the gene-level TUC_G matrix deposited with GSE49711 to the survival annotations deposited for the same patients in GSE62564; the transcript-level GSE62564 matrix and the overlapping GSE49710 microarray are not treated as additional cohorts.

metadata.source_data_system: NCBI GEO GSE49711 expression and GSE62564 outcome records
metadata.library_method: Primary-tumor mRNA sequencing aligned to hg19 and quantified with Cufflinks; TRACE uses the source gene-level TUC_G log2(FPKM + 1) matrix.
metadata.endpoint_context: Source-defined overall survival from neuroblastoma diagnosis
metadata.endpoint_caveat: The source OS event denotes death from disease. TRACE preserves the OS label and event definition and does not reinterpret it as all-cause mortality.
metadata.sample_selection_note: Exactly one gene-level RNA profile is linked to each of 498 patients. Source matrix column suffixes are normalized deterministically to the SEQC_NB patient key, with collisions prohibited.
metadata.treatment_note: The tumors are source-described as primary, but prior-treatment status at sampling is not documented consistently and remains unknown; TRACE does not label the cohort treatment-naive.
metadata.overlap_note: GSE49710 is a microarray and GSE49711/GSE62564 represent the same 498 biological patients. They are registered once and must never be counted as independent studies.
metadata.secondary_endpoint_note: The source also reports event-free survival for all 498 patients (183 events and 315 censures). This release exposes OS while the GEO adapter's multi-endpoint contract is being extended; it does not create a duplicate EFS study.

samples.sample_role: Primary neuroblastoma tumor; treatment status at sampling unknown

expression.label: Provided gene-level log2(FPKM + 1)
expression.mapping_source: Source-provided gene symbols in the pinned GSE49711 TUC_G matrix
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: All 23,146 source gene symbols are non-empty and unique; no implicit aggregation is applied.
expression.scale_note: The pinned SEQC README defines the TUC_G values as gene-level log2(FPKM + 1). TRACE preserves that scale without a second transformation.

endpoints.label: Overall survival (source-defined disease death)
endpoints.event_definition: Death from disease as encoded by the source OS event
